observations: Photo 0 shows multiple used water storage containers outdoors.
Center: a white IBC tote inside a galvanized metal cage with a tap at the base.
Left: tall black ribbed vertical plastic tanks standing together.
Right: a black plastic tank with a white logo and unreadable text below it.
Foreground: a black ribbed circular plastic tank or drum open at the top.
Far right edge: part of another white caged IBC tote.
Seller text says the items are used to store water in the house and different places.

claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: The items are water tanks, but the seller's usage cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: The white IBC tote may have previously held non-potable chemicals, making it unsafe for drinking water without verification.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any embossed UN/DOT code, label, or stamp on the IBC tank or cage showing previous contents.
risks.if_unproven: price as not safe for potable water / chemical residue risk

risks.risk: Any tank may have cracks, leaks, or failed valves not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Video clip showing each tank filled with water and inspected for leaks, especially around seams and the IBC tap.

risks.risk: The metal cage on the IBC tote may be rusted, bent, or have broken welds.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the cage corners, welds, and base pallet.

proof_requests: Close-up of markings or labels on the white IBC tote to identify previous contents.
Video of all tanks being filled with water to test for leaks.
Close-up photos of the IBC cage welds and tank seams.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as used water storage tanks by type, so it can be priced at its worst case as seen; the seller's usage claim is unverifiable remotely and hidden risks around chemical residue and leaks must be priced down until proven otherwise.
